name: Micron Advanced Assembly and Test Taiwan 2, Taichung
aliases: Micron Taichung second advanced packaging plant
summary: Micron's second advanced packaging and test plant in Taiwan, set up in Taichung to add HBM capacity because its existing advanced packaging space was running short. Micron began converting an existing building at its Central Taiwan Science Park Houli site in 2025, with conversion work reported to have started in September 2025, and held the opening ceremony on 15 October 2026. Micron said the plant's planned 2027 output was already sold out; capacity and investment were not disclosed.

location.site: Central Taiwan Science Park, Houli Park

milestones.note: Conversion of an existing building; trade press dates the start to 2025 and a news report to September 2025.
HBM production expected from mid-October 2026, as stated by Micron Taiwan at its October 2026 media briefing.
Opening ceremony attended by the President of Taiwan and the economics minister.

notes: Reports differ on what the building was before conversion: one trade press report calls it a former warehouse at the Houli site, another news report a former spring factory. The first Taichung advanced packaging plant is the separate record micron-taichung-aatt-fab-4. Reports of the 15 October 2026 opening describe the plant as ready for HBM volume production but do not confirm that output had begun; the operating status rests on the opening ceremony.
